course.learn: This section focuses on **Attributes** within **Attributes of actors**. Threat-actor attributes describe where an attacker is located, what access they already have, how skilled they are, and what resources they can use.
course.why: Two actors can use the same attack but present very different risk depending on privilege and capability.
course.example: A low-skill external attacker may rely on public tools, while a privileged insider may need little technical sophistication to steal sensitive files.
course.exam: Internal/external, resources, sophistication, and access are common classification clues.
